title: Sales
description: Mockup: the sales process from interest to contract as a funnel and a board, with a deal drawer (gate checklist, timeline, risks, next skill) and the skills and workflow per stage.
insights: Design mockup with fictional data; no CRM is connected and nothing is sent. Offers and contracts mirror the Sub4Me sample data.
Every stage has exit criteria (a gate) and a human approval for the risky steps; the skills only prepare and check.
Each deal shows the next skill to run, with the sentence to type in the chat.
prompt: Bundled example: Sales (static mockup, data embedded by npm run sync:mockups).
